What is the best ab workout and the best ab exercises? In this video I'm tested 30 popular upper ab exercises, lower ab exercises, and all kinds of ab workouts to find what is actually best.
Sit-ups started poorly: they're easy to load, but the floor limits the stretch and EMG showed the hip flexors taking over through the second half. Crunches reduced that hip-flexor involvement, but still couldn't provide a deep stretch. An ab mat or rolled-up towel fixed that and pushed it to A-tier.
